# Vendored SVG Finalize Helpers

This directory vendors the `svg_finalize` helper package from the `ppt-master`
skill implementation.

`vendor/svg_to_pptx` uses these helpers in memory for data-icon expansion and
positional `tspan` flattening during native PPTX conversion. The implementation
is used under the MIT License.

Local source used for this vendor import:

```text
/home/fecyj/.agents/skills/ppt-master/scripts/svg_finalize
```
